Two dial/knob controls and a small red indicator light visible on the control panel (photo 1).
Power cord visible hanging from the unit in photos 1 and 2.

risks.risk: Control dials/timer switch may be faulty or unresponsive.

risks.risk: Wall bracket and swing-arm mechanism may be loose, rusted, or unsafe for reinstallation.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the bracket's wall mounting screws/anchors and a clip of the arm swinging smoothly.

risks.risk: Power cord/plug could be frayed or damaged, posing a safety risk.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the full length of the cord and plug.

risks.risk: Hood interior (heating coils, vents) could be dusty, corroded, or mold-affected from salon use.
risks.proof: Photo looking up into the underside of the hood with vents visible.
risks.if_unproven: priced as worst case, assuming uncleaned/degraded interior

proof_requests: Video of the dryer plugged in and running, showing heat and fan response to dial changes.
Close-up of the wall bracket's anchoring screws and the swing-arm hinge in motion.
Close-up photo of the power cord and plug end.
Photo looking up into the hood interior to check vents and heating coil condition.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a Mango-branded wall-mounted salon hood hair dryer in cosmetically good condition, but no proof of actual working function (heating, fan, dial control) is shown, so it must be priced at the worst case of an unverified/non-functioning unit until a power-on demonstration is provided.
